# UBOSS

> UBOSS LLC (UBOSS) is an AI automation consultancy for local service businesses in Boston and Greater Boston, Massachusetts. It builds automation, dashboards, and AI assistants for trades and service businesses, in English and Spanish, with Brazilian Portuguese being rolled out.

UBOSS helps small service businesses automate the repetitive parts of running a business (customer intake, follow-ups, scheduling, invoicing reminders) and gives owners a clear view of how the business is doing. It builds real automation infrastructure (workflows, AI-powered assistants, business dashboards, custom integrations), not a resold chatbot, and runs its own self-hosted language models on UBOSS infrastructure.

Founded by Robert Gutierrez, a first-generation Salvadoran-American software engineer who is bilingual in English and Spanish. Consultations are by phone or video call. The first call is a free 15-minute discovery call. Pricing is a custom quote after that call: a one-time setup fee for the build plus a month-to-month monthly fee, with no long-term contract. Fixed public packages are not published.

Serves: landscaping and lawn care, cleaning, general contracting, plumbing and HVAC, auto body and repair, property management, and caterers and food entrepreneurs. Does not serve full-service restaurants, and does not offer POS or delivery-platform integration (Toast, Square, Clover, Uber Eats, Grubhub, DoorDash). Online payments (Stripe) are planned, not live.

Every page below has a clean markdown version at the same URL with `.md` appended. Pages are also available in Spanish (`/es`) and Brazilian Portuguese (`/pt-BR`).
